##### Project general facts

South Lofts 2 is the second phase of the South Lofts community by Premier Choice International, conceived as an elevated co-living residence for a modern, flexible lifestyle. The low-rise building combines a podium of shared spaces with residential floors and a rooftop dedicated to leisure, wellness and work. The residences comprise studios and one-bedroom apartments, with selected first-floor homes opening onto private terraces and select one-bedroom layouts offering an optional private plunge pool upgrade.

The amenities are organised into themed zones that support different moments of the day. The podium brings together an amphitheatre, a courtyard with an aqua deck, a grill and barbecue garden, an outdoor cinema, social seating and leisure loungers, alongside a centre court with table tennis, a trampoline, a pet play area, an outdoor gym, a strolling path, a running track and a meditation sanctuary. The rooftop features an infinity pool with in-pool perches, sunken loungers and poolside showers, a co-working lounge with collaboration tables, work booths and focus zones, a games area, and a fully equipped gym with active and strength zones.

Interiors are designed with warm, natural tones and clean detailing, with open living suites, fitted kitchens and contemporary bathrooms. The homes are delivered without a furniture package. Smart living features include an Amazon Echo Show smart hub, centralised control of lighting, real-time energy monitoring, ORVIBO smart panels in every apartment and a digital smart door lock with app-based remote access. A welcoming foyer sets the tone on arrival.

##### Location description and benefits

Dubai Industrial City is a fast-growing district in the south of Dubai, positioned between Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road and Emirates Road within the wider Dubai South growth corridor. The area combines established industrial and logistics activity with new residential communities, green spaces and expanding infrastructure. Its position offers direct road links towards the major business and leisure districts of the city.

Expo City Dubai, Jebel Ali Free Zone and Al Maktoum International Airport are within a short drive, supporting daily commutes for professionals working in the region. Ibn Battuta Mall, Dubai Parks and Resorts, Palm Jebel Ali and Dubai Marina are easily reached for shopping, entertainment and waterfront leisure. The neighbouring Emaar South community and the nearby Jebel Ali Port complete the setting of this well-connected district.

Dubai Industrial City appeals to young professionals and investors looking for accessible entry prices in a district with strong long-term growth prospects. The concentration of employers in logistics, aviation and trade supports steady rental demand for compact homes such as studios and one-bedroom apartments. Tax-free ownership and access to the Dubai Golden Visa add to the appeal for international buyers and first-time investors.
